subject: Launch readiness: timeline compression and documentation handoff
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Simon Price <simon.price@nuancehealth.com>, amy.cho@nuancehealth.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch readiness: timeline compression and documentation handoff

Hi Simon / Amy —

Quick update from our side as we look at the go-live window for the Nuance Health pilot. Product has asked if we can pull the target GA window in by 5 business days to support Nuance's commercial kickoff on 2026-06-23. Current internal target is 2026-06-23; ask is to move to 2026-06-18.

Summary of what that would require from teams and questions for you:
- Docs: need confirmed owners for the activation binder, runbook, and support FAQ. I attached a draft deployment runbook (deployment-runbook-v1.pdf).
- Exceptions: if any integrations (SAML, EHR connector) are not ready, we need an exception lane owner to run a controlled canary.
- Procurement/legal: Ben, can you confirm whether an accelerated SOW/PO path is possible for Nuance? Simon/Amy, do you have a firm procurement deadline?

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal owners confirm by EOD 6/10 who will own the three docs and who will be the exception owner.
2) Ben to flag procurement timeline and whether DocuSign/SOW can be prioritized.
3) Vivek to confirm SRE capacity for a compressed staging window and canary plan.

Links and attachments:
- Drive draft: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3DriveLink
- Attachment: deployment-runbook-v1.pdf (see event checklist and rollback triggers)
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4521/RDW-8742

Simon/Amy — if pulling in the date is a blocker on your end, speak up now. If you can accept the earlier window we will commit to daily standups next week for final gating.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Product Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Simon Price <simon.price@nuancehealth.com>, amy.cho@nuancehealth.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch readiness: timeline compression and documentation handoff

Thanks Marissa — quick acknowledgements and constraints.

I agree we can try to compress but two hard asks from SRE/Infra:
1) We need a confirmed staging window for at least 24 hours of sustained traffic (load test) before any canary cutover.
2) If there is a SAML or EHR connector mismatch, we should not block the launch entirely — we can run a feature-flagged fallback and use the exception lane. That needs an owner for on-call escalation.

I will review the runbook and PR a short supplement describing the SRE gating criteria by EOD 6/10. For owners: Vivek (SRE gating), Marissa (docs owner triage), Ben (commercial/procurement touchpoint). If Laura wants to assign a formal exception owner that's fine.

On staging capacity: I can commit to reserving one dedicated node pool for the 6/15-6/18 window if legal and procurement can sign off on a temporary committed spend.

Vivek
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

Team —

Decision: Approve timeline pull-in to 2026-06-18 with the following conditions. Please treat this as an executive GO with exceptions controlled by the template and daily status until GA.

Conditions and owners:
- Docs: Marissa to own the activation binder and publish final runbook by 6/14 COB. Use the deployment-runbook-v1.pdf as the baseline.
- SRE gating: Vivek to own the staging load test and sign the gate on 6/15 after the 24-hour soak.
- Procurement: Ben to secure accelerated SOW turnaround; if PO not confirmed by 6/16, the canary path must be used and feature-flagged.
- Exception owner: Laura Bennett (assigning myself) to triage any cross-team escalations; update the exception-tracker-template.xlsx daily and post status in the SUP-329 ticket.

Reporting cadence: daily standup 09:30 PT starting 6/14, and an escalation channel in Slack #nuance-pilot. If any team sees a blocker that changes the timeline by more than 24 hours, escalate immediately to me and cc the customer thread.

I'll expect the final binder and the SOW redline by end of day 6/14. If we miss those, we delay.

Laura Bennett
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
